parts.text: The choice of a life partner is one of the most important decisions you will ever make. Many people do not have clarity regarding this and are confused about how to make that decision.

In this clarity call, I will provide you counsel on how to navigate the process of choosing a life partner and also analyze your current relationship (if you are in one) whilst providing guidance on your decision.
I will help you analyze your standards to be sure they are not unrealistic, unnecessary, and sub-standard.
One Hour Dating Couples Counseling Session

This is a one-hour counseling/coaching session for a dating couple. In this session, you will be able to identify your unhealthy patterns, improve your communication & conflict resolution skills and gain insight into making an informed decision about your relationship
In this session, it is compulsory for both partners to turn their videos on and be present.
